title: layered_sim per-event CSV
description: First line '# SIMULATION', second line the column names, then one row per event (numbers printed with 10 significant digits). In MT mode each worker writes CSV.thread<N> and the master merges them sorted by event number.

columns.name: event
columns.description: event number (first_event + Geant4 event ID)

columns.name: chunk
columns.description: chunk number

columns.name: weight
columns.description: primary vertex weight

columns.name: primary_pdg
columns.description: PDG code of the primary

columns.name: primary_ekin_MeV
columns.description: primary kinetic energy

columns.name: primary_x_mm
columns.description: gun position

columns.name: primary_dx
columns.description: primary direction cosine

columns.name: edep_<slab>_MeV
columns.description: weighted energy deposit (G4Step total energy deposit) summed over the copies of the slab, including energy G4UserSpecialCuts booked for killed tracks

columns.name: chlen_<slab>_mm
columns.description: track length of charged particles in the slab

columns.name: plen_<slab>_mm
columns.description: path length of the primary in the slab (geantino material-budget scans)

columns.name: edep_copy<i>_MeV
columns.description: deposit per placed copy (output.per_instance only)

columns.name: edep_world_MeV
columns.description: deposit in the world volume

columns.name: leak_gamma_MeV
columns.description: kinetic energy of photons leaving the world

columns.name: leak_e_MeV
columns.description: kinetic energy of e-+ leaving the world, plus 2 m_e c^2 for an e+ (TestEm3 convention)

columns.name: leak_nu_MeV
columns.description: neutrinos leaving the world

columns.name: leak_other_MeV
columns.description: every other particle leaving the world

columns.name: leak_rear_MeV
columns.description: all leakage (as the four category columns) through the +x end face of the world

columns.name: leak_front_MeV
columns.description: all leakage through the -x end face (albedo, backscatter)

columns.name: leak_lateral_MeV
columns.description: all leakage through the y and z faces

columns.name: killed_booked_MeV
columns.description: kinetic energy at the start of the step in which G4UserSpecialCuts killed a track (already in the deposits; an upper bound when that step had continuous loss)

columns.name: killed_unbooked_MeV
columns.description: kinetic energy of secondaries killed at stacking (not deposited)

columns.name: killed_eplus
columns.description: number of killed e+ (they do not annihilate)

columns.name: exit_ekin_MeV
columns.description: primary kinetic energy when it leaves the world (0 if it did not)

columns.name: primary_eloss_MeV
columns.description: primary kinetic energy minus exit_ekin_MeV

columns.name: exit_dx
columns.description: primary direction cosines when it leaves the world

columns.name: primary_fate
columns.description: +1 transmitted (left going +x), -1 reflected, 0 stopped or absorbed

columns.name: primary_end_x_mm
columns.description: x where the primary ended or left

columns.name: primary_end_process
columns.description: process that ended the primary (Transportation when it left the world; none if it never ended)

columns.name: n_sec_gamma
columns.description: number of secondary photons

side_outputs.materials.json: density, radiation length, nuclear interaction length, mean excitation energy, electron density and elements of every material in use, from the Geant4 material table after /run/initialize: for the material-budget closure only, never a reference input
side_outputs.datapaths.json: Geant4 version and the dataset variables before initialisation and after the run (the paths Geant4 resolved)
side_outputs.stdout: the Geant4 log; 'LAYERED_SIM_UI "<command>" <code>' per UI command and a last line 'LAYERED_SIM_STATUS {json}'
